inputs.text: They’re putting Terry Pheto and the alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal in the spotlight, but that may be deliberate: give the public one recognizable person to focus on while the institutions involved control what is said and what remains hidden. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. A briefing and an SIU probe don’t reveal the whole story, and the more this is framed as being about one person, the more I’d ask whose interests that serves.
